title: A representable functor is an algebraic space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: a scheme T of the big fppf site has representable functor h_T which is an algebraic space (source lines 1067-1072). The proof verifies the three defining conditions one by one: h_T is a sheaf (an earlier remark of the chapter), its diagonal is representable because h_T x h_T = h_{T x T} and the site has fibre products, and the identity map h_T -> h_T serves as a surjective etale chart.
